shadows.name: editor-panel
shadows.purpose: Separate the Word Counter working surface from the canvas.

motion.name: extension-dock
motion.purpose: Bring each module into the extension showcase once as the sequence plays.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Show static homepage artwork when the visitor requests reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Default size on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.25rem .75rem; border:0; border-radius:9999px; font:500 .875rem/1.75rem "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; background:var(--color-olive-950,#000); color:#fff; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--color-olive-800,#343434); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-foreground,#000); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Dark theme primary button
components.description: Default size on a dark surface.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.25rem .75rem; border:0; border-radius:9999px; font:500 .875rem/1.75rem "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; background:var(--color-olive-300,#ddd); color:#000; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--color-olive-200,#eaeaea); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ddd; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Demo form field
components.description: Labeled text field in light mode.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.375rem; font:500 .875rem/1.5rem "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:.625rem 1rem; border:0; border-radius:.75rem; background:white; color:black; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); font:400 .875rem/1.75rem "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #494949; outline-offset:2px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); }

components.name: Extension catalog card
components.description: A linked catalog entry with its name and details action.
components.css: .ds-card { display:grid; gap:1rem; padding:1.25rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 15%,transparent); border-radius:.75rem; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; font:400 1rem/1.5rem "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card span { font-size:.75rem; } .ds-card:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 5%,transparent); } .ds-card:hover span { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: FAQ disclosure
components.description: A ruled disclosure with a plus that becomes a minus when expanded.
components.html:
Where is my work stored?

On your device, in Lunaris Cloud or on your server.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-block:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 15%,transparent); font:400 1rem/1.75rem "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-faq summary { cursor:pointer; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; min-height:4rem; box-sizing:border-box; padding:1rem 0; font-weight:500; } .ds-faq summary::after { content:"+"; } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { content:"−"; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-faq p { margin:0; padding-bottom:1.25rem; font-size:.875rem; }

narrative.overview: On the homepage, the lunar landscape draws attention to the headline and the recorded demo. Below it, each section answers one question about the workspace. Inner pages give the largest share of space to the visitor’s task, whether that is choosing a download, comparing plans, finding an extension or editing text.
keyCharacteristics: Separate sections for extensions, storage and enterprise access
dos: Do keep a common left edge between hero copy and video, and give the video the full container width.
Do separate a visitor’s primary task from supporting links and explanations through spacing, order and type scale.
donts: Don’t tint images to match the interface or give each section its own accent.
Don’t rely on motion, hover or an icon alone to explain a destination.
